items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of resident parking permit
items.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung können Sie Widerspruch erheben; er muss innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde, bei der Stadt Musterbüll, Markt 1, 25899 Musterbüll, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift eingehen.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 2027-06-14, sent by post. The letter states the Bekanntgabe fiction: 'Für die Bekanntgabe zählt bei Postversand der vierte Tag, nachdem der Bescheid zur Post gegeben wurde' (this matches the current statutory rule under §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / corresponding SH law, which was extended from 3 to 4 days effective 2025 due to slower statutory postal delivery standards). Counting 4 days from 14.06.2027: 15.06 (Tue) =1, 16.06 (Wed)=2, 17.06 (Thu)=3, 18.06 (Fri)=4 → deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on Friday 2027-06-18. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins the day after the triggering event (§187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 2027-06-19, and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the day of Bekanntgabe, i.e. 2027-07-18. Counting from Friday 2027-06-18 (anchor date given for this task), 30 days later (12 days remaining in June + 18 days in July) falls 2 days after a Friday = Sunday, so 2027-07-18 is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB (applicable via §57 Abs. 2 VwGO), a period ending on a Sunday is extended to the next business day: Monday 2027-07-19, which is not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein.

items.title: Submit declaration of permanent private use of the vehicle to have the application re-examined
items.quote: Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach, prüfen wir Ihren Antrag gern erneut.
items.computation: The letter invites the recipient to submit a declaration that the vehicle NF-JM 512 may be used privately on a permanent basis, so that the parking permit application can be re-assessed. No specific calendar date or deadline period is given for this submission in the letter, so no fixed due date can be computed; it is an optional step the person can take at any time (though doing so before the Widerspruch deadline of 2027-07-19 would allow it to be considered together with any objection).

warnings: The letter states that postal delivery counts as effected on the 'vierter Tag' (4th day) after posting; this matches the current statutory rule (§41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, extended from 3 to 4 days as of 2025), so no error, but the resulting Widerspruch deadline (2027-07-19) should be verified against the actual delivery date of the physical letter if known, as the statutory fiction only applies if the letter was indeed received around that time.
